source_refs.title: Download apps on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.applicability: iPhone (the page covers iPhone and iPad); published October 22, 2026
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Double-click the side button on the right side of your iPhone
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: On your iPhone or iPad, open the App Store. Browse the Today, Games, Apps, or Arcade tabs, or tap the Search tab to look for a specific app. Tap the price or Get button. If you see the Open button instead, you already bought or downloaded the app. You might need to enter your Apple Account password to complete the download. Confirm the purchase by double-clicking the side button on your iPhone. With Face ID, glance at the device. With Touch ID, rest your finger on the button. An app with a Get button instead of a price is free, and you won't be charged to download it. Free apps may offer in-app purchases and subscriptions.

source_refs.title: Download apps to your Android device - Android Help
source_refs.applicability: Android phones and tablets; the page says some of these steps work only on Android 8.0 and up
source_refs.verified_excerpt: When you pick an app, tap Install (for no-charge apps) or the app's price.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: Open Google Play. On a phone or tablet, use the Play Store app. Find the app you want. Check the app's reliability. Under the app's title, look at its star ratings and number of downloads. To read individual reviews, scroll to the 'Ratings and reviews' section. When you choose an app, tap 'Install' for free apps, or tap the app's price for paid apps. Some of these steps work only on Android 8.0 and up.

source_refs.verified_excerpt: Select Start, then select Microsoft Store.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: Select Start, then select Microsoft Store. In Microsoft Store, choose Apps or Gaming. To see more of any category, select Show all. On your taskbar, select the Microsoft Store icon, then select More info up by your account picture. Select My Library. Select the Download icon to download and install the app or game. Any app or game with a Download icon next to it hasn't been downloaded yet.
